infrastructure_boundary: The exact GitHub raw file could be fetched through the connected GitHub source reader, but direct raw-file transfer into the local sandbox was network-blocked. The relevant release_integrity functions were transcribed from the exact observed source for the ablation. Therefore this is not byte-import exact-source execution credit.

fixture.source_tree: one regular payload link/owned.txt plus canonical F2 release manifest
fixture.archive: deterministic ZIP_STORED with fixed member timestamps

A_FRESH_EMPTY_STAGING_THEN_F2_POSTVERIFY.interpretation: Fresh staging plus post-extraction manifest verification is compatible with the current F2 release-integrity invariants for this fixture.

B_PREEXISTING_SYMLINK_DESTINATION_THEN_F.extract_result: CPython extraction followed destination/link and wrote payload into sibling outside directory
B_PREEXISTING_SYMLINK_DESTINATION_THEN_F.interpretation: The current F2 post-materialization verifier prevents promotion of this hostile staged tree, but it cannot undo an extraction-time write that already escaped into a pre-existing destination link.

primary_result: The existing F2 release-integrity verifier is an effective post-extraction promotion fence for a symlink-bearing staged tree in this bounded Linux fixture. It is not by itself an extraction sandbox. A fresh/private disposable staging root materially changes the consequence: the clean control stayed confined and verified, while the pre-existing-link arm caused an outside write before F2 correctly rejected the tree.
architecture_implication: Do not weaken or replace release_integrity; reuse it after extraction.
Normatively require fresh/private disposable staging before any ZIP extraction used by the one-handoff path.
Do not execute/import/install package contents before the post-extraction F2 verification succeeds.
Add archive-member preflight for deterministic cross-platform names/duplicates/special metadata so extraction behavior is not delegated blindly to host defaults.

Do not require Linux openat2 for the portable baseline unless concurrent hostile staging mutation becomes an accepted threat model; keep it as a stronger optional/platform-specific future discriminator.

counterhypothesis_status.postverify_alone_is_enough: FALSIFIED_FOR_PREEXISTING_HOSTILE_DESTINATION_SIDE_EFFECT; verification rejects but occurs after escaped write
counterhypothesis_status.fresh_private_staging_plus_postverify_is: NOT_ESTABLISHED; concurrent hostile mutation/race and platform-specific aliasing were not tested
counterhypothesis_status.f2_release_integrity_is_the_bug: NOT_SUPPORTED; it rejected the hostile materialized tree as designed

resource_measurement.reason: This ablation isolates correctness boundaries, not target performance.
